title: Constrained N-Queens
statement:
Count ways to place one queen in every row of an n×n board so no two attack, keeping all preplaced queens.

Input
n, then n rows of n characters. Q denotes a preplaced queen and . an unrestricted cell. Each row has at most one Q. Preplaced queens may conflict.

Output
Print the number of valid complete placements.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 14.
